description: A bedroom nightstand vignette photographed at seated eye-level, roughly 3–4 feet high, with a normal lens and an off-center thirds composition. The camera is positioned to the left of the nightstand, angled slightly to capture the right portion of the bed and the full nightstand arrangement in a three-quarter view. The accent wall behind the headboard is painted a deep warm chocolate brown — a rich, earthy tone that absorbs light and anchors the space with depth. Against this dark wall, a directional warm beam of light emanates from a mounted position high on the wall, creating a distinct conical pool of warm amber illumination that falls across the upper headboard panel and fades softly into the dark wall around it. The headboard is a tall floor-to-ceiling upholstered panel in light grey linen-textured fabric with vertical channel tufting — refined and architectural in scale. The bed itself is dressed in crisp white cotton bedding with a charcoal grey accent pillow and a chunky sage-green knit throw folded across the foot. The nightstand is a small round-drum form in dark walnut with a satin finish and two small drawers with slim brass bar pulls — compact and elegant. On the nightstand surface sit a clear drinking glass with water and a matte white ceramic bud vase holding a few stems of dried eucalyptus with dusty green leaves. A matte black rocker-switch wall plate is mounted on the headboard panel at bedside-control height. The corner of the adjacent white-painted wall is visible at the far right edge. The mood is quiet, contemporary, and warmly restrained.
